stories.title: NBA Future Power Rankings: We stacked the three-year outlooks for all 30 teams
stories.summary: How does your team look in 2026-27? What about in 2029? NBA insiders unveil the latest rankings, based on five key metrics.

stories.title: LSU QB Leavitt unexpectedly listed as doubtful for Ole Miss rivalry game
stories.summary: In a surprising turn of events, LSU listed starting quarterback Sam Leavitt as doubtful for Saturday. The exact nature of his injury is unclear.

stories.title: Jets suspend star goalie Hellebuyck after training camp no-show
stories.summary: The Jets on Wednesday night suspended star goalie Connor Hellebuyck for failure to report to the team's training camp.

stories.title: Kyrie offers to pay Al-Shaair's fine for tribute to slain Palestinian girl
stories.summary: Kyrie Irving offered to pay Texans LB Azeez Al-Shaair's $11,941 fine for having the name of a Palestinian girl killed in Gaza in 2024 written on his eye black during a game.

stories.title: FBS oversight committee can't overturn WMU loss despite improper protocols
stories.summary: The NCAA's FBS oversight committee acknowledged that replay protocols were not properly followed at the end of Western Michigan's controversial loss to Michigan in Week 1 but said it does not have the authority to overturn the result of the game.
